principles: Religion Badge progression represents knowledge, observation and practice; Badge points never create employment, academic standing or institutional authority by themselves.
Besøkende, Nysgjerrig, Tradisjonskjenner, Ritualkjenner, Symboltolker and Troslivskjenner are employment-independent knowledge and participation states.
Feltarbeider remains a useful fieldwork-practice identity, but the generic label is too ambiguous to create a fixed job or salary automatically.
Academic and research titles require explicit qualification or employment evidence before a formal position can be offered.
Fagansvarlig and leadership titles require a concrete employer appointment before they can become active positions.
Religion salary tiers reuse the existing History humanities/heritage game-economy bands; they are not claims about Norwegian market salary.

sources.title: Historiker
supports: Religionshistoriker is registered in the occupational title family connected to historian work.
Historical professional work is based on source criticism, analysis, documentation and communication.

sources.title: Religionsvitenskap, master
supports: Advanced study in religious studies prepares for research and work involving communication, advising and cultural understanding.
Religionsvitenskap is an academic competence path, not a title conferred by Badge progression.

sources.title: Kurator
supports: Kurator is a real occupation involving selection, interpretation, planning and execution of exhibitions or collections work.
The role belongs to a formidling/kulturarv work world rather than being a prestige status.

sources.title: Forsker
supports: Research work is a formal professional path with academic competence and employment context.
Forsker and Seniorforsker must therefore be separated from knowledge-game rank.

sources.title: Konsulent i offentlig sektor
supports: Konsulent, fagkonsulent and seniorrådgiver are real work-title families used for professional administrative and advisory work.
Registered titles include consultancy connected to religious work, supporting a religion-specific advisory work world.

notes: Feltarbeider is resolved as fieldwork practice with no fixed-salary career contract.
Religionshistoriker and Religionsviter remain real professional identities, but formal employment is fail-closed behind relevant qualification or employer evidence.
Research and leadership authority is never inferred from Religion Badge points.

salary_mapping.principle: salary_tier selects an existing Civication game-economy band and is not a Norwegian salary estimate.
